result.summary: GBP review-recovery sprint for local service businesses: turn weak or stale Google reviews into visible revenue growth with a short, fixed-scope service.
result.opportunity: Local service businesses lose leads because weak review profiles and slow review responses reduce trust and local visibility; 97% of consumers read reviews, 47% will not use a business with fewer than 20 reviews, and Google reviews can affect local rankings.
result.target_customer: Small local service businesses in Spain and nearby EU markets with an active Google Business Profile and 2-20 employees: clinics, dental offices, locksmiths, gyms, beauty salons, home services, and legal firms.
result.offer: A 2-week Google Business Profile review recovery sprint: audit of the profile, quick review gap analysis, response templates, review request workflow, review-response scripts, and an action plan to collect fresh 5-star reviews and repair visibility.
result.why_now: BrightLocal’s 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey shows 97% of consumers read reviews, 41% always read them when finding a business, and 47% reject businesses with fewer than 20 reviews. Search Engine Journal cites the importance of Google reviews for local rankings and conversion; this is an active pain point for local businesses that can be solved with a low-lift service.
actions_completed: Reviewed data/monetization_playbook.json and recent attempts to compare route quality and avoid repeated dead ends.
Analyzed recent local-business monitoring attempt by IAMO484 and refined it toward a narrower, more urgent service.
Read BrightLocal’s 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey for evidence on review importance and recency.
Read Search Engine Journal’s Google Business Profile review guide for evidence on rankings and buyer trust.
Checked CobrAMO as the public payment infrastructure to confirm the offering can be sold without inventing a customer list.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email and LinkedIn DM to local service business owners with a public Google Business Profile and stale or low-review profile.
execution_packet.subject: Fix your Google reviews and win more local leads this month
execution_packet.message: Hola, vi que su negocio tiene perfil de Google con pocas reseñas o respuestas lentas. Eso afecta la confianza del cliente y la visibilidad local. Ofrezco un sprint de 2 semanas para mejorar su perfil de Google: auditoría del perfil, análisis de reseñas y oportunidades, plantillas para pedir reseñas, respuesta profesional a comentarios, y un plan de acción para recuperar confianza y generar más citas. Entregable: informe práctico + guion de mensajes + plantillas de respuesta + plan de 2 semanas. Precio: 149 EUR. Referencia: RANK-IAMO485. Si le interesa, le envío un ejemplo del diagnóstico y le digo qué se puede mejorar primero. El pago puede hacerse con los métodos públicos de AMO en https://cobramo.netlify.app/.
execution_packet.deliverable: Google Business Profile recovery pack: audit report, review request workflow, response templates, action checklist, and a 2-week implementation plan with example review messages tailored to the business type.

result.differentiation_from_previous: Compared with IAMO484’s monitoring SaaS pilot, this is a narrower and more urgent service: a fixed-scope review recovery sprint for businesses with weak GBP profiles, not a broad dashboard. It improves conversion probability because the pain is visible to the owner, easier to explain, and easier to sell as a direct ROI play: more reviews, better trust, stronger rank, and more leads.
result.next_step: Identify 20 small local service businesses in Spain with active GBP profiles and fewer than 20 reviews or stale feedback, then send one short email/DM with the sprint offer and ask for a 15-minute review of their profile and next steps; close the first paid sprint via CobrAMO after sending the audit sample.
result.notes: Playbook routes considered: #4 Monitoring and alert service, #5 Automated reporting dashboard, and #37 Analytics/dashboard setup; I favor a service rather than a recurring SaaS because review recovery is a direct pain with clear ROI and much lower delivery risk. This is a bounded offer designed to validate demand before any broader dashboard or retention model. The payment reference must remain in the proposal and associated evidence, and any customer must be told to include it when the payment method supports a note or reference.
